name: Legislative Palace of Uruguay
scope: Standing Legislative Palace of Uruguay in Montevideo, including the principal southern stair and side ramps, four cardinal porticoes, four open courts and the square lantern over the main hall.
era: Standing 1925 Legislative Palace, based on the cleared 2006 facade and current mapped footprint.

references.artist: No machine-readable author provided. Shant~commonswiki assumed (based on copyright claims).

originalReview.notes: The southwest street photograph documents the south porch with its relief pediment and four clear freestanding Corinthian columns between heavy antae, broad divided steps, pale stone facade, corner pediments, dark inset windows and sculpted square lantern.

review.method: Exact published Qualla image, native uploader revision and public-domain release
review.notes: Native 2006 uploader and earliest wikitext explicitly credit Federico Corral, known as Shant, and release the photo worldwide by PD-self. The Qualla file is byte-identical to this original.
